The '''gazarant''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. The [[Lower Coromon Chain]] was home to gazarant feeding grounds, which helped to prevent prisoners from escaping.<ref name="CatCW" />
